item.title: Tokyo’s historic Hyakudan Kaidan building reopens after one year
item.description: A new event features fewer exhibits than in the past to allow visitors to better experience the architecture and its ornaments from the 1930s.

item.title: India set to overtake Japan as fourth-biggest economy next year, adviser says
item.description: India has done well on job creation and income growth, V. Anantha Nageswaran said, but he acknowledged that youth unemployment remains a problem.

item.description: As a result, Toyama city may have received more funding from the central government than it should have.

item.title: Australia’s largest pension fund eyes India, Japan for private equity
item.description: Asia currently accounts for about 10% of AustralianSuper's total private equity portfolio.

item.title: Japan’s real wages rise again, aided by Takaichi’s relief
item.description: Real cash earnings — adjusted for inflation, excluding rents — climbed 1.5% in August from a year earlier, the labor ministry said.

item.title: Indian opposition MPs detained in protest against election chief
item.description: Opposition leaders have alleged that CEC Gyanesh Kumar manipulated voter rolls to favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party during elections.

item.title: 'Not again': Arrest of US marine for murder reignites protests in Japan's Okinawa
item.description: For many locals on this island, the arrest has brought decades of frustration back to the fore.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
